title: Remove or stub integration_test dependency
objective: Ensure integration_test is either removed when unused or backed by a minimal passing placeholder suite.
acceptance_criteria: integration_test dependency is removed from pubspec.yaml if no integration tests are retained
If integration_test remains, integration_test/ contains only tests that can pass in the current frontend-only environment
No broken driver-only integration test entry point remains
flutter test can run without failing because of integration_test configuration
pubspec.lock is updated if dependency changes require it
